label: class_b_03_math_01
text: Hello, everyone. Let’s have a fun class today.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_02
text: Tell me, do you all enjoy fortune telling,\nhoroscopes, and the like?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_03
text: I think it feels great to read your horoscope and\nsee that it says good luck is coming your way.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_04
text: So today, I’d like to teach you all math while\nfocusing on the topic of luck![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_05
text: Perhaps you have seen the following phrase\ncrop up during Pokémon battles before...\c\n“A critical hit!”[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_06
text:
When a Pokémon’s attack lands as a critical hit,
the damage it deals is increased by half.\c
In other words, it does one-and-a-half times as
much damage as it normally would![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_07
text: It is truly luck that determines whether your\nPokémon lands a critical hit—or has one landed\r\non it. This can cause a great upset in battle.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_08
text: Does anyone know what percent chance a\nPokémon has of landing a critical hit?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_select_01
text: About 1 percent (1 in 100 hits)

label: class_b_03_select_02
text: About 4 percent (4 in 100 hits)

label: class_b_03_select_03
text: About 12 percent (12 in 100 hits)

label: class_b_03_math_answer_01
text: Oh, my. Critical hits land a little more often than\nthat, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_answer_02
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]That is correct! Well done,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_answer_03
text: Oh, my. That might cause a bit TOO critical of a\nsituation, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_09
text: The chance of landing a critical hit is said to be\n1 in 24...which figures to roughly 4.17 percent.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_10
text: The odds are more favorable for certain moves,\nthough—why, moves such as Stone Edge and\r\nShadow Claw have about a 12 percent chance![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_11
text: You can also use a move called Focus Energy or\nan item known as a Dire Hit.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_12
text: Both raise the critical-hit ratio by two stages—\nthat’s a 50 percent chance to land a critical hit![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_13
text: It feels great to land a critical hit, but perhaps\nnot so great to be struck by one![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_14
text: There is a surprising amount of mathematical\nprobability hidden in Pokémon battles, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_15
text: If you’re able to do the calculations that’ll swing\nluck in your favor, it may open the door for more\r\nstrategic choices for you during battle.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_16
text: Oh, my. Is that the bell? I suppose that’s all for\nnow. What a shame...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_03_math_17
text: Next class will be our fun midterm exam! I hope\nyou’ll all be looking forward to it.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
